To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the spiro[4.5]ketales are synthesized on solid support, (2) the spiroketals are obtained in high overall yield and with high stereospecificity and (3) the spiroketal library contains compounds that inhibit phosphatase activity and modulate the integrity of the tubulin-based cytoskeleton in cancer cells.

we developed a new method to prepare spiroketals in an efficient, scalable and enantioselectivemanner and that we synthesized a collection of spiroketals that modulates the formation of the cytoskeleton.

the spiro[ 5.5] ketals of the natural product spirocyclophane (1) are readily synthesized on solid support in high overall yields, and that the resulting spiroketal library contains compounds with phosphatase inhibiting and tubulin polymerization modulating activities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of synthetic strategies for the preparation of spiroketals.
the development of new methods for the synthesis of spiroketals and their use for the preparation of compound collections with a common structural framework.
the synthesis of biologically active spiro[5,5]ketal compounds.

the spiro[4.5]ketales are a very useful and versatile class of compounds that are easily accessible in enantiomerically pure form.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

a new, efficient, and versatile method has been established for the synthesis of spiroacetal compounds, which are of great interest for medicinal chemistry, as they are found in a number of natural products with interesting biological activities.
a spiro[5,5]ketal library has been prepared by solid phase synthesis and that the library contains compounds that modulate microtubule formation.
we have established a new methodology for the synthesis of spiroacetal natural products.
The main takeaway from our work is that
spiro[5,5]ketals can be synthesized efficiently in a stereoselective manner on solid phase.
spiroketal-containing natural product-derived compound collection can be generated by a simple, enantioselectivie, solid phase synthesis.
